name: Baron Bloodmore and the Crimson Castle

features.name: Massive mystery symbols
features.description: Large blocks that reveal a single symbol.

review:
A vampire castle on 25 lines with multiplying cash wins, massive mystery symbols and two bonus games. The gothic art is some of Thunderkick's best.

The giant mystery symbols can cover a big chunk of the grid, which is where the bigger hits come from. Very high volatility and a 25,000x cap, 96.07% RTP. Expect patience to be part of the deal.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
